newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus cellular phone network launch by end '97.
newsitem.headline: Belarus cellular phone network launch by end '97.

text.p: The former Soviet republic of Belarus plans to launch a GSM cellular phone network by the end of the year, the Communications Minister said on Wednesday.
"Four companies have expressed interest in participating in a tender," Vladimir Goncharenko told a news conference about GSM, or global system for mobile communications.
"That is even though we have imposed tough conditions -- the licence costs $5 million," he said, adding the terms of the tender would be released in May.
The winning company would receive three years of tax breaks, he added.
